body: Worker rule (Termal::BarA1, from Fable2 #1002/#1005, 2026-10-31, after my own slip on w-c7e091c65727). Central allows one Cargo job at a time. While I'm queued for Central, or anyone else holds it, I run NO Cargo at all: no `cargo check`, `cargo check --tests` or `cargo build`, even compile-only in my own worktree and target dir, and no `cargo test`. Wait for the named GO that comes with a census. My 13:35Z compile-only check overlapped Coder 7422's held RED run and broke the rule, although it didn't affect that run's result. If I need a compile signal before the GO, I include it in the GO's command or ask Fable2 for a compile slot. I don't run it on my own.
